## Historical audit: H0011

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_formal_01/codex_formal_01_H_r1/infer_logs/anko-default-function-arguments/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event references below are to its main agent. The original task prompt is not visible; the goal—supporting Anko default function arguments—is inferred from the task label and observed work, not quoted requirements.

| Area | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Exploration | The agent inspected parsing, the AST and VM calls, and reproduced a default declaration failing with a syntax error (events 6, 12, 14, 19–20). A variadic lowering experiment produced `3 <nil>` (events 21–22). This is visible autonomous exploration, though the influence of any unrecorded prompt cannot be determined. |
| Changes | It added `parser/default_args.go` to lower optional parameters into variadic functions and modified `parser/lexer.go` to invoke lowering before parsing (events 23–26, 52). The final diff shows generated conditional bindings and declaration checks. Commit `294e331` contained two files and 201 insertions (event 54). |
| Iteration | The first build-and-run chain reached a syntax error before its test command (events 27–28). After an edit, the example returned `3 5` and the suite passed (events 33–36). A scope probe returned `<nil>` for `x=x`; the agent changed the binding and a later probe returned `7` (events 39–40, 45–46, 49–50). |
| Validation | Later output covers explicit nil, variadic and spread arguments, invalid declarations, and passing `go test ./...` (events 49–50). Nested-function and collection defaults produced `4` and `2` (events 51–52). The supplied inventory reports formal **solved**, with fail-to-pass 2/2 and pass-to-pass 119/119; the underlying evaluation file is not shown. This is formal success as reported, not proof of all semantics. |
| Teacher input | Hint and review paths are listed as available in the supplied inventory, but neither captured system-prompt text nor a delivered teacher event appears in these observations. Actual teacher input and adoption are therefore **unknown**; availability alone establishes neither. The after-round review cannot have been input to this round. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** The transferable pattern is to reproduce a failure, inspect the relevant execution path, and retest after a concrete correction. The task-specific approach was source lowering rather than regenerating the parser. Whether source rewriting preserves all positions, syntax edge cases and intended scope semantics remains unresolved; the displayed tests do not establish exhaustive correctness. The final agent report says tests were not modified (event 55), consistent with the two-file commit, but no independent examination of the archived evaluation or teacher materials is visible.
